about: Hand-written claims against the real Ambetter Texas SBC and EOC indexes in data/indexes. 'good' claims are true and correctly cited, written the way a model might (paraphrased claim text, quotes with case, quote-mark and whitespace differences). 'bad' claims must be rejected, with the expected reason. 'limitation' claims are false but pass, because the verifier proves a quote exists, not that the claim follows from it.
